*The hill path Shade used to bring caravans in by has tracks on it too large for any boar. Shade needs a new way past the Tusk Path: hunt 40 beasts along it and reach its far end.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 Tusk Path beasts in [The Tusk Path](../maps/tusk_path.md)
2. Reach the far end of the Tusk Path in [The Tusk Path](../maps/tusk_path.md)
